description: as cfd_3d_net_wall, the quasi-static wall net written to the LAGOON store instead of its .vtk files (P 18 1) every 10 steps: REEF3D_CFD.lagoon with the particle set cfd_net (role net: the knots with Tension, the bars as lines with the number of their net), the outputs 0, 1, 2 as the .vtk files would be (the start: the state after the first step, as its file is left); no REEF3D-Net .vtk file. The solution is that of the case without the store.
